doc: Copies arg0->count (field at offset 0x24) pointer entries out of arg0's inline array (starting at offset 0x04) into a 4-slot stack buffer, sorts the buffer via the qsort-style func_8004AFC8 helper using comparator func_8004F85C, then re-links each adjacent sorted pair back into their owning doubly-linked list via func_80044AAC(buf[i], buf[i+1]) (insert-after). Finishes with two more per-object hook calls, func_8004F684(arg0) and func_8004F780(arg0).
calls: func_8004AFC8(void *base, s32 count, s32 size, int (*compar)(void*, void*)) -- matched qsort-style helper (src/code8.c declares it identically); called as func_8004AFC8(buf, arg0->count, 4, func_8004F85C)

func_8004F85C(void *a0, void *a1) -> int -- matched comparator (declared in src/code.c as func_8004F85C(Level0*,Level0*)); passed only as a function-pointer value (address), no call-site arg mismatch risk
func_80044AAC(void *a0, void *a1) -- matched linked-list insert-after (declared in src/w_80044AAC.c as func_80044AAC(S_80044AAC*,S_80044AAC*)); called pairwise over the sorted buffer
func_8004F684(S_8004F884_arg *a0) -- still INCLUDE_ASM, called with arg0 unmodified
func_8004F780(S_8004F884_arg *a0) -- still INCLUDE_ASM, called with arg0 unmodified
